name: KEE Fresh & Safe Foodtech Co., Ltd.
summary: "Established by Liao Jih Hsing on June 9, 2011, KEE Fresh & Safe Foodtech Co., Ltd. specializes in the development, manufacturing, and commercialization of products that leverage High Pressure Processing (HPP) technology. Based in Pingtung, Taiwan, the company's offerings prominently include various vegetable juices and other functional beverages."
